topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I just found out that the place where I’ve spent countless evenings, the one spot that got every visit just right, is shutting down. They’ll flip the sign to ‘closed’ for the last time next month. The chairs will be stacked, the tables cleared, and the lights, those warm, greeting lights, will flicker out. It’s hard to stomach, really. I keep thinking about the last time I’ll walk in, feeling like a traitor for knowing the place won’t stay. All those nights, the laughter, the meals that felt like home, just... gone. It’s a strange sensation, knowing a part of your routine, a piece of your city, is about to vanish.
